item.title: Netanyahu says he has directed IDF to increase control of Gaza to 70%
item.description: The expansion in control by Israel would contradict the terms of the ceasefire Israel and Hamas agreed to in October 2025.

item.title: Dozens killed in Lebanon as Israel intensifies strikes
item.description: Israel says it struck 100 Hezbollah infrastructure sites and fighters in Lebanon, after PM Benjamin Netanyahu vows to "crush" the Iran-backed group.

item.title: Iran condemns US strikes as 'gross violation' of ceasefire
item.description: The attacks took place while Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks.

item.title: More than 1.5m foreign pilgrims begin Hajj despite Iran war fears
item.description: Saudi Arabia says that is 11,000 more than the number of Muslims who travelled to the Gulf kingdom last year.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut and southern Lebanon after large-scale evacuation orders
item.description: The Israeli military has ordered Lebanese residents to leave some 17% of the country's territory.

item.title: Iran says it targeted American base after fresh US strikes
item.description: The hostilities come during a fragile ceasefire between the US and Iran, and protracted negotiations to end the three-month war.

item.title: Netanyahu says Israel will intensify strikes against Hezbollah
item.description: The Israeli military hits targets in eastern Lebanon after the prime minister announces further strikes.

item.title: The Papers: 'Putin pushes Nato to brink' and 'groundbreaking' breast cancer test
item.description: Several of the papers have focused on the Russian drone that hit a block of flats in Romania on Friday.

item.title: Trump tells US negotiators 'not to rush' into deal with Iran
item.description: The deal under discussion would involve a 60-day ceasefire extension during which the Strait of Hormuz would be reopened, according to US media.

item.title: Israeli strike in Gaza City kills new head of Hamas's military wing
item.description: Hamas says Mohammed Odeh was killed alongside his wife and two children in a strike on a residential building.
